newsitem.title: USA: Texas Instruments bomb parts test a success.
newsitem.headline: Texas Instruments bomb parts test a success.

text.p: Texas Instruments Defense Systems & Electronics division said on Wednesday it successfully qualified the PAVEWAY III Laser Guided Bomb (LGB) Guided Bomb Unit (GBU) 22 on the F-16 aircraft.

Texas Instruments, which paid for the testing, said in a statement it was conducted by the U.S. Air Force between April and June. The company said it made the guidance electronics and control section for the PAVEWAY Laser Guided Bombs.
The division also made a tail section that helped stabilize the weapon during flight. The bombs were used during the Gulf War, it said.
